body.name: Hthr
body.construction: Source-preserving threshold-extension handle: recover the conditional success probability required in each natural-treatment stratum from a chosen \((c,d)\in F(A,B)\), collect the finitely many response probabilities needed by both experimental tables, and seek one common ordered-threshold private root \(W0\) and one deterministic map \(fY\) realizing all of them without coupling \(U0\) and \(V0\).
